- bunq 开户即关｜bunq Help（2026-10-24 查阅）：可因风控/资料问题立即永久关户；关户后 app 仍可查原因与提现；公开页未写「开户即关潮」 https://help.bunq.com/en/articles/why-was-my-account-permanently-closed https://help.bunq.com/en/articles/who-can-open-a-bunq-personal-account
